releaseNotes: - Saved measurements: New Order saves them only when the order is placed; Manage Order always saves edited values. Only changed fields are written.
- Manage Order shows Bill total, Received, Balance and Credit; credit is kept in the order history.
- Customer search by ID, full phone, +91 and part of a phone, or name (small typos tolerated).
- Add Customer location is one type-to-search box; Close Shirt, Police Uniform and Two Piece garment types.
- Bill print is larger (155 x 227 mm); the slip after Confirm Bill shows the real balance.
